📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-03-ms-scheduler-api-seriesid-negative-recordid`
Occurrence #156 (last post 11-23 23:37Z). Single tenant this window: *apislogik5*.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Playbook: missing recordId guard in GetSeriesIdAsync (unsaved Activity, recordId=-1). Open Jira: none filed.
Monitor 303750093 `[CRM][P1] ms-scheduler-api error rate high`: Warn 23:20:33Z (11-24) → Triggered 23:25:33Z → Warn 23:35:33Z → Recovered 23:39:33Z.

Root-cause analysis (run this cycle):
  • ES `fields.dd_service.keyword:"ms-scheduler-api" AND level.keyword:Error` 23:05-23:45Z: 24 hits. 24/24 are `Failed to Get Series Id for record -1 in table Activity` (inner `Invalid attempt to read when no data is present.`)
  • 24/24 from apislogik5, 23:13-23:32Z. Stack: `Scheduler.Core.Providers.SeriesDataProvider.GetSeriesIdAsync` (SeriesDataProvider.cs:143) ← `SeriesService.GetSeriesIdAsync` (SeriesService.cs:71)
  • Reasoning: exact KB signature, one account, overnight low volume pushes the error rate over the threshold.

Suggested next action: file the defect (early-return or 400 on recordId ≤ 0 in GetSeriesIdAsync). 156 occurrences and still unfiled.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-04-crm-amqp-consumer-monitor-family-quiet-period-flap`
Occurrences #202-#205 (4 overnight fires; last post 11-23 04:24Z). One post covers all 4. The later 3 are logged to docs/actionable as suppressed.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`) for runtime-core-subscriber; `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`) for method-mobile-notifications-subscriber
Playbook: quiet-period low-traffic dip, no errors; self-recovers. Open Jira: none.
  • 302057011 runtime-core-subscriber throughput: Triggered 02:29:31Z (rec 02:31Z), Triggered 03:38:31Z (rec 03:45Z)
  • 302055141 mobile-notifications-subscriber heartbeat: No data 09:06:21Z (rec 09:29Z), No data 10:39:21Z (rec 10:49Z)

Root-cause analysis (run this cycle):
  • DD metric `sum:trace.amqp.command.hits{service:runtime-core-subscriber,env:prod}.as_rate()` 01:45-04:00Z: 28-61/s until 02:07Z, then 0.5-4.8/s overnight (min 0.067/s @03:51Z) vs the monitor's `avg(last_15m) < 2`. DD logs `service:runtime-core-subscriber status:error`: 0.
  • DD metric `...{service:method-mobile-notifications-subscriber}` 07:30-10:55Z: series empty 08:04→09:28Z and 09:38→10:48Z (no messages to consume), 0.017-0.17/s when present vs `avg(last_60m) < 0.005`. Errors: 0.
  • Reasoning: low traffic, not a stalled consumer. Zero errors on both services.

Suggested next action: none for ops. Monitor tuning (time-of-day floor) is still the structural fix.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
Occurrence #297 (last post 11-23 23:33Z).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Vertical App Experience` (`@sales management` / `#team-sales-management`)
Playbook: latency-only RTC p95 spikes, no errors. Open Jira: none.
Monitor 117279738 `RTC Action Execution has a high p95 latency`: Triggered 04:08:18Z → Recovered 04:16:18Z.

Root-cause analysis (run this cycle):
  • DD metric (monitor query) `p95:trace.aspnet_core.request{env:prod,service:runtime-core-api,resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/_actionid_*}` 03:40-04:30Z: 9 of 150 points > 3.0s, peak 4.30s @04:02Z. Same window 24h earlier: 4 points > 3.0s, peak 3.35s.
  • DD logs `service:runtime-core-api status:error` 03:50-04:20Z: 0 (latency-only)
  • APM spans > 5s 03:55-04:15Z: 1 (POST /api/v1/runtime/{actionid}/{screenid}/{activerecordid} 14.5s @03:57:44Z)
  • Reasoning: a few slow action executions at overnight volume move p95. Matches the KB.

Suggested next action: monitor.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-07-notifications-p95-latency-monitor-noise`
Occurrence #53 (last post 11-23 09:31Z).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `CRM Experience` (`@customer-management` / `#team-customer-management`)
Playbook: monitor fires but the re-queried metric never approaches the threshold. Open Jira: none.
Monitor 302056327 `[CRM][P2] notifications P95 latency high`: Triggered 09:31:07Z → Recovered 09:41:07Z.

Root-cause analysis (run this cycle):
  • DD metric `p95:trace.aspnet.request{service:notifications,env:prod}` 09:00-09:50Z: 0 of 150 points > 1.0s. Max 0.546s @09:30Z, otherwise ~0.001-0.02s.
  • Hits `.as_count()`: burst of 1,595 @09:30Z (the daily ~09:30Z send). The fire lands at 09:31:07Z, the same minute as 11-21 and 11-23.
  • DD logs `service:notifications status:error` 09:10-09:45Z: 0
  • Reasoning: the alert does not reproduce on re-query. Artifact of the daily burst, per the KB.

Suggested next action: none for ops. Tune the monitor (min-hits guard or exclude the 09:30Z batch).

🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 4)
Channel: alert-system  •  bug-type guess: data  •  alerts in group: 1
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Vertical App Experience` (`@sales management` / `#team-sales-management`)

Symptoms:
  - Monitor 236570583 (Watchdog stories) Triggered 05:39:03Z → Recovered 06:48:03Z. Story `6512e6c1`: "Latency increased on the POST /api/v1/datatable/{screenid}/{activerecordid} resource in runtime-core-api"
  - p95 for that resource 03:30-07:30Z: a single 1-minute point at 8.91s (05:28Z). Everything else is 0.04-0.23s. 24h-earlier max was 0.285s. Volume is 1-61 hits/min.
  - 0 runtime-core-api error logs 05:00-06:30Z

Trace IDs: 6b0671de00000000b672277ff1b222b5 (8.85s @05:27:58Z), 6b0672cb00000000b0671f0945c34df7 (10.98s @05:31:55Z). Both HTTP 200, host agxcel2.method.me, prod-rt-02.
Likely cause: account-specific. An agxcel2 Estimate Line grid with an image column runs a per-row `Select [ItemAGItemPicture] From [viewaccEstimateLine] Where [RecordID] = @recordId` (~2.4s each, 5 in one trace) and generates 256x256 thumbnails to S3 on the fly. Two grid loads were enough to move p95 on a low-volume resource.
Suggested next action: monitor. Low impact (1 account, 2 requests). If it recurs, look at the viewaccEstimateLine image read (per-row N+1 against a heavy view) for agxcel2.

Score: +3 critical-path (runtime-core) +2 novel −1 monitor history (236570583: 1 posted of 5 fires/30d) = 4, exactly at the gate. agxcel2 user count unavailable (account_impact not_found: prod3/4/5 clusters unconfigured this session). Operator-engagement and swat checks were not possible (no Slack MCP).
